quote: The driver of a vehicle shall not overtake and pass another vehicle upon the right when such movement requires driving off the paved portion of the highway.

activation.condition: Driver overtakes and passes another vehicle on the right of a separately classified paved public highway.

obligation.description: Do not overtake and pass upon the right when that movement requires driving off the paved portion.

timing.description: Measure original body overlap and paved-edge departure through whole pass; preserve physical-necessity judgment.
